title: RobotExpressive: rigged, animated low-poly robot character
description: A cartoon low-poly robot humanoid with a full skeleton, 14 animation clips (idle, walk, run, jump, dance, wave, punch, death, sit) and three facial-expression morph targets, in one small glb with flat colours and no textures. Good for a player character or NPC.
attribution: Tomás Laulhé (Quaternius); glTF conversion and morph targets by Don McCurdy
author: Tomás Laulhé (Quaternius)
scale_hint: about 4.5 units tall at scale 1: scale 0.4 for a 1.8-unit character; origin at the feet, facing +z
thumb_licence: CC0-1.0 (rendered by raea from the CC0 model)
raea: renders, skinned and animated; render equals baked play (sdk/motion/bench/bevy/character, SSIM 1.000)
